# ClinicOps

ClinicOps is an evidence-controlled clinical-operations practice. Its current commercial beachhead is EU medical-device regulatory information integrity, evidence reconciliation and change propagation for manufacturers, authorised representatives and regulatory partners worldwide that support the EU market.

Current medical-device services:
- Regulatory Integrity Review: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-gate.html
- Global EU-market regulatory integrity: https://clinicops.dk/eu-mdr-regulatory-integrity.html
- Class III Transition Map: https://clinicops.dk/class-iii-transition.html
- EUDAMED transition support: https://clinicops.dk/eudamed-transition.html

Adjacent clinical-operations lanes being tested, not represented as validated:
- Trial Change Integrity Review
- QMS Change Integrity Review
- Clinical AI Evidence Review
- Overview and evidence boundaries: https://clinicops.dk/clinical-operations.html

Free browser-local tools:
- Regulatory Change Integrity Check: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-check.html
- Regulatory Change Review Cost Calculator: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-economics.html
- EUDAMED Identifier Check: https://clinicops.dk/identifier-check.html
- Transition Readiness Score: https://clinicops.dk/readiness-score.html
- Browser-local scope brief: https://clinicops.dk/assessment-intake.html

Research:
- https://clinicops.dk/research.html
- https://clinicops.dk/research/eudamed-watch/
- https://clinicops.dk/research/sscp-public-record-scan/

Important boundaries:
- Machine findings are evidence-control signals, not legal, regulatory, clinical, safety or compliance determinations.
- Missing public records or links do not by themselves establish non-compliance.
- Source authority and expert judgement remain explicit human decisions.
- Public-source coverage is bounded by the stated method and must not be represented as a complete EUDAMED audit.
- Adjacent TrialOps, QualityOps and Clinical AI Ops offers remain in market validation until real buyer evidence meets ClinicOps validation gates.
